lefty.linePrev: Pancho needs your prayers, it's true
lefty.line: But save a few for Lefty, too
lefty.lineNext: He just did what he had to do
stanza: Well, the poets tell how Pancho fell
Lefty's living in a cheap hotel
The desert's quiet, Cleveland's cold
So the story ends, we're told
Pancho needs your prayers, it's true
But save a few for Lefty, too
He just did what he had to do
And now he's growing old

lefty.line: And Lefty, he can't sing the blues
lefty.lineNext: All night long like he used to
stanza: And Lefty, he can't sing the blues
All night long like he used to
The dust that Pancho bit down south
Ended up in Lefty's mouth
The day they laid poor Pancho low
Lefty split for Ohio
And where he got the bread to go
Ain't nobody knows
